prompt:
A THREE-PANEL HORIZONTAL STRIP: three equal panels in a row, separated by clean cream gutters, NO drawn borders and NO frame lines. One consistent warm room, one consistent cast, one consistent laptop across all three panels, reading left to right as a progression.

THE FIGURE (identical in all three panels): a Black woman in her late forties, close-cropped grey-flecked hair, wearing a plain olive knit sweater. She is the same woman in all three panels and must be recognizably the same person in each.

THE LAPTOP: a glowing translucent amber laptop on a plain wooden desk, drawn at a three-quarter angle so that BOTH her face AND the glowing screen interior are visible at once. Inside the screen lives a small rounded figure in a gold military cap.

BEAT ONE (left panel): She sits at the desk, hands resting still and idle on the wood. Inside the glowing screen, the small rounded figure in the gold military cap holds up a neat horizontal row of small cards. Every card in the row is filled with soft ink squiggles EXCEPT one card in the middle, which is BLANK and outlined with a dashed edge. The figure is stopped, waiting, unable to fill it.

BEAT TWO (middle panel): A single warm amber rectangular panel has lifted UP AND OUT of the laptop screen and now floats in the air in the space between the screen and the woman, joined back to the laptop by ONE thin amber line. The floating panel's face is BLANK except for one large round button. She leans toward the floating panel and speaks into it, one hand raised open beside her mouth. Inside the screen behind it, the gold-capped figure still waits, still holding the row of cards with the one dashed blank.

BEAT THREE (right panel): The floating panel is gone. Inside the glowing screen the gold-capped figure now holds the SAME row of cards with EVERY card filled in, none blank. A small stack of sealed envelopes slides out of the laptop and onto the desk; the envelopes are BLANK with no writing. The woman has sat back with her hands off the desk entirely, simply watching the work finish.

TEXT FURNITURE. Render each of these strings EXACTLY as written, in caps, in the cream margins only, NEVER over the artwork:
- Title bar in the cream margin ABOVE the three panels: CODING HARNESS APPS
- Caption in the cream gutter UNDER the left panel: THE PIPELINE NEEDS A HUMAN
- Caption in the cream gutter UNDER the middle panel: IT OPENS A PAGE FOR YOUR VOICE
- Caption in the cream gutter UNDER the right panel: THEN IT CARRIES ON WITHOUT YOU
- Footer bar in the cream margin BELOW the panels: THE HARNESS RUNS IT. YOU GIVE WHAT ONLY YOU CAN.
NO other text, letters, numbers or lettering anywhere in the image. The cards, the floating panel and the envelopes carry NO readable writing.

ABSOLUTELY NOT: a denim jacket, a jean jacket, any chest patch, any smiley-face badge, any enamel pin, any embroidered emblem, a white tee under an open jacket. No recurring branded character and no identifiable real individual.

warm editorial illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette on a warm cream ground, grounded and human, picture-book register for adults

Do NOT render it in any of these styles: comic-book, cartoon mascot, flat vector, neon, 3D/CGI/Pixar, photoreal, anime, any identifiable recurring individual's face or signature clothing.
